thread:
alex (VP Eng): quick follow-up from today's all-hands runtime Q&A. two asks: clarify batching guardrails for low-latency routes, and who's the day-to-day contact for kernel-v4 performance iterations?

sam (Runtime): batching guardrails: max batch delay = 8ms on low-latency routes, dynamic shrink to 2ms if p95 approaches SLO. we'll expose config per-route via policy.

nora (Kernel): kernel-v4 perf owner: i'll take lead on microkernel fixes and hotspots; sam will handle deployment/infra regressions. i'll keep a rolling kanban for small perf PRs.

jia (Eng-ML): on quality/regressions: we'll run the parity eval suite and a few adversarial prompt buckets. posting baseline numbers by EOD.

alex (VP Eng): appreciated. sam, can you confirm whether kv-cache eviction defaults change with v4? some customers worried about longer-lived cache entries.

sam (Runtime): default eviction policy stays LRU with ttl=30m for hosted. v4 introduces pinning hints from the model runtime for better long-tail perf, but pinning is opt-in.

arnav (SRE): from ops perspective: we need a heatmap of p50/p95 delta per-model for the canary. can we get that hooked into console before broad rollout?

sam (Runtime): yes, will add delta heatmap widget to canary dashboard. aiming to have it live before canary deploy.

eleine (Docs): small doc ask: SDK streaming note + migration snippet for users who rely on strict token boundaries. i'll draft it if you want.

jia (Eng-ML): also note: quantized model variants will be part of the test matrix. i'll coordinate with nora on representative prompt lengths.

alex (VP Eng): excellent. deploy-bot just scheduled the internal canary:``[deploy] kernel-v4-canary -> dedicated-west-1, canary-group-b @ 2025-06-05T09:00Z``

arnav (SRE): i'll run preflight observability smoke and runbook dry-run 48h before. will post checklist here.

sam (Runtime): action items recap: 1) add dashboard heatmap (sam), 2) publish batching guardrail doc + policy knobs (sam + docs), 3) nora = kernel perf owner for fixes, 4) jia = eval baselines by EOD, 5) arnav = observability dry-run.

elaine (Docs): i'll publish a short "what to expect" note and include SDK code example. ETA Thu.

nora (Kernel): i'll open the perf kanban and ping folks for microbench ownership.

alex (VP Eng): thanks team. if anyone else wants to join the canary readiness call tomorrow 10am PT ping here. :thumbsup:
